name: Pine Cliffs Ocean Suites
positioning: Pine Cliffs Ocean Suites, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa, Algarve: a contemporary clifftop suite resort above Praia da Falésia in Albufeira, home to the Serenity Spa
best_for: Families wanting suites and apartments with kitchens and a large playground
Golfers wanting a 9-hole clifftop course on site

facts.text: The resort is at Praia da Falésia, Pinhal do Concelho, in Albufeira, Portugal.
The resort has modern architecture and a contemporary style, set among historic gardens and ochre cliffs crowned with pine trees.
Pine Cliffs Ocean Suites is at the heart of the wider Pine Cliffs resort and is home to the Serenity Spa.
Accommodation ranges from suites to one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, all with private balconies.
The suites have fully equipped kitchens.
The bedroom suites have floor-to-ceiling windows and en-suite bathrooms with a rainfall shower and custom-blended amenities.
The Presidential Suite has two bedrooms, a fully equipped kitchen, a jacuzzi and an expansive terrace with sunbeds and an open-air dining area.
Spa treatment spaces include the Japanese-inspired Sakura room, a hydrotherapy bath and a marble hammam.
The spa's signature treatment uses traditional Algarve ingredients such as fleur-de-sel from Ria Formosa, sand from Falésia Beach, carob and orange oil.
The golf course's signature hole, the Devil's Parlour, has a tee shot over the top of the cliff to a large undulating green.
Tennis and padel are offered at the Annabel Croft Tennis Academy, with expert coaching and tailored programs.
Mirador Champagne Bar sits above the Atlantic, serving champagne at sunset and signature cocktails.

highlights.text: The resort sits on ochre cliffs above the Atlantic, close to Praia da Falésia, with direct access to the beach via a private lift.
The Serenity Spa's Thermal Oasis has a hydrotherapy pool, Himalayan salt sauna, herbal sauna, steam room, Kneipp therapy pool, ice fountain and outdoor Jacuzzi.
The Pine Cliffs Golf Course is a 9-hole course set along the cliffs with views of the Atlantic, designed by architect Martin Hawtree.
The spa's private Serenity Aurum Suite has a steam room, sauna, Jacuzzi, experience shower and a double treatment room for couples or friends.
The Porto Pirata playground has bouncy castles, a basketball court, two swimming pools for kids, a mini golf course and two life-size pirate ships.

considerations.text: Rollaway beds are not permitted in the rooms.
Water sports such as jet-ski, kayak and stand up paddle are provided at Falésia Beach during the summer.
A facility fee is added to all stays; it cannot be paid with points and must be paid at check-in.
